statement: Build a warm, homely, phone-friendly one-file website for Kaveri Kitchen, a South Indian restaurant in Kothrud, Pune, where visitors can see the priced menu with a veg/non-veg filter, today's specials, book a table on WhatsApp, find the address and hours, see dish photo spots and read customer reviews.
audience: People in and around Pune looking for South Indian food, mostly on phones, deciding what to eat and whether to book a table.
standards: Warm and homely look and tone
Works well on phones: readable at 360px wide, tap-friendly buttons, no sideways scrolling at 360px or 1280px
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
No JavaScript errors, no broken in-page links
Only facts supplied by the Requester appear on the site
rules: Do not invent dishes, prices, offers, discounts, photos, reviewers or contact details
No offers or discounts are shown because none exist right now
Photos are shown as empty labelled photo spots until real pictures exist
Bookings go through WhatsApp only, for tables of 1 to 8 people
done_when: The menu lists exactly these 11 dishes with prices in rupees: Starters: Medu vada 120, Veg cutlet 140, Chicken 65 260. Mains: Masala dosa 160, Mysore dosa 180, Idli sambar 110, Veg thali 280, Chicken chettinad 340, Fish curry meal 360. Desserts: Payasam 100, Filter coffee 60
Each dish is marked veg or non-veg (non-veg: Chicken 65, Chicken chettinad, Fish curry meal; all others veg), and All, Veg and Non-veg filter buttons show only the matching dishes
A Today's specials section shows Mysore dosa and Fish curry meal
A Book a table button opens WhatsApp (wa.me link) for +91 00000 33333 with a prefilled message asking for name, date, time and number of people, and the page says tables are for 1 to 8 people
The page shows the address 7 Karve Road, Kothrud, Pune 411038, the hours 8am to 10:30pm every day with kitchen closing at 10pm, and the restaurant phone +91 00000 44444 as a tap-to-call link
A dish photo section shows empty labelled photo spots for dishes, with no fake or stock photos
A reviews section shows exactly these three: "Best dosa in Kothrud" by Anita R., "Feels like home" by Vikram S., "Great filter coffee" by Neha P.
The site name Kaveri Kitchen appears in the page title and header, and a navigation lets visitors jump to menu, specials, booking, photos, reviews and contact
The page has a viewport meta tag and layout rules for narrow screens, with no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px
The file contains no offers or discounts and no placeholder text such as lorem ipsum or TBD
visitor_needs: Filter the menu by veg and non-veg
Find the address and opening hours
